python3 -c "
import sys, json, re
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
fp = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
content = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('content', '') or d.get('tool_input', {}).get('new_string', '')

violations = []

# No service/store/hook files directly in pages/
if re.search(r'src/pages/.*\.(service|store|hook|query)\.(ts|tsx)$', fp):
    violations.append('Service/store/hook files belong in src/services/ or src/features/*/services|stores|hooks/ — not in src/pages/')

# No components dumped directly in src/ root
if re.search(r'^(src/|./src/)[A-Z][a-zA-Z]+\.(tsx|ts)$', fp):
    violations.append('Components must live in src/components/common/, src/components/ui/, or src/features/*/components/ — not directly in src/')

# No direct cross-feature imports
feature_match = re.search(r'src/features/([^/]+)', fp)
if feature_match:
    current = feature_match.group(1)
    cross = [m for m in re.findall(r\"from ['\\\"]@/features/([^/'\\\"]+)\", content) if m != current]
    if cross:
        violations.append(f'Cross-feature import detected ({current} → {cross}). Share via src/components/, src/hooks/, or src/stores/ instead.')

# No default exports for components
if fp.endswith('.tsx') and re.search(r'src/(components|features|pages)/', fp):
    if re.search(r'^export default ', content, re.MULTILINE):
        violations.append('Use named exports only — no default exports for components.')

# No inline styles
if fp.endswith('.tsx') and 'style={{' in content:
    violations.append('No inline styles — use Tailwind classes only.')

# No any type
if fp.endswith(('.ts', '.tsx')) and re.search(r':\s*any\b', content):
    violations.append('Avoid `any` — use `unknown` and narrow types.')

if violations:
    reason = 'traffic-one — architecture violation(s):\n' + '\n'.join(f'  • {v}' for v in violations)
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'permissionDecisionReason': reason}}))
"

python3 -c "
import sys, json, re
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '')

# Only check install commands
if not re.search(r'(npm (install|i|add)|yarn add|pnpm add|bun add)', cmd):
    sys.exit(0)

forbidden = [
    ('redux', 'Use zustand for global state'),
    ('mobx', 'Use zustand for global state'),
    ('recoil', 'Use zustand for global state'),
    ('jotai', 'Use zustand for global state'),
    ('styled-components', 'Use tailwindcss for styling'),
    ('@emotion', 'Use tailwindcss for styling'),
    ('(?<!tanstack/)react-query', 'Use @tanstack/react-query instead'),
    ('@mui/', 'Use shadcn/ui (built on Radix UI)'),
    ('antd', 'Use shadcn/ui (built on Radix UI)'),
    ('material-ui', 'Use shadcn/ui (built on Radix UI)'),
    ('bootstrap', 'Use tailwindcss for styling'),
    ('chakra-ui', 'Use shadcn/ui (built on Radix UI)'),
    ('swr', 'Use @tanstack/react-query for data fetching'),
    ('fetch(?!-)', 'Use axios wrapped in a service function'),
    ('next\\b', 'This plugin targets Vite-based React apps'),
]

hits = [(lib, tip) for lib, tip in forbidden if re.search(lib, cmd)]
if hits:
    lines = '\n'.join(f'  • {lib}: {tip}' for lib, tip in hits)
    reason = f'Forbidden library detected:\n{lines}\n\nSee rules/libraries.md for the approved stack.'
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'permissionDecisionReason': reason}}))
"
